# Getting help

- **How do I…, does Zerostel fit…, what about…:** ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/zerostel/zerostel/discussions).
- **Something doesn't record, rewind or report as it should:** run `zerostel doctor` first. It checks Node, git, each agent's hooks, your config and guardrails, and says what's wrong. If that doesn't explain it, open a [bug report](https://github.com/zerostel/zerostel/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) with its output.
- **A security problem:** report it privately, as [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) describes.

The [README](../README.md) covers installing, every command and the limits. Guardrail recipes are in [docs/guardrails.md](../docs/guardrails.md), CI in [docs/ci.md](../docs/ci.md), and how it works inside in [docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md).
